meta.finalPromptText: Visit https://photomed.app and find 3 specific, verified grant programs or fellowships. For each: program name, eligibility, deadline, application URL, contact email. Verify each by visiting the official grantor website. Create a 10-slide pitch deck outline for PhotoMed tailored to each opportunity. Return: all sources as URLs, mark claims VERIFIED or state 'could not verify'. Output as JSON.
